description: Ministry of Energy - The Petroleum Resources (Minimum Qualifications of the Appointed Members and the Director General) Regulations, No. 1 of 2021
reasoning: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Minister of Energy under the Petroleum Resources Act, No. 21 of 2021. It establishes minimum qualifications for appointed members of the Board of Directors and the Director-General of the Petroleum Development Authority. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks created under an existing Act of Parliament.
